bio: The menu of this former 1900s station buffet features generous cuisine that places freshness above all other virtues! You can have lunch or dinner in the brasserie, in a convivial setting, with a repertoire of regional classics that have made restaurant’s reputation (pâté en croûte, quenelle de brochet, frogs' legs), or a few modern “creations” (snails braised in olive oil with star anise, cloves and juniper…)....
